sections.What it does:
The site is where somebody who has installed nothing reads what `kac` is and how to use it. It has a page for each `kac` verb, the framework pages, the corpus descriptor reference and the tool's changelog.

A page's content can come from outside `docs/`. `docs/changelog.md` is a snippet of `tooling/kac/CHANGELOG.md`, so a release changes the site without any file under `docs/` changing. Taken from the header comment in `.github/workflows/publish-docs.yml`.

Every page lives under `docs/`. The site is not a corpus: `publishing-target: mkdocs` in a corpus descriptor is a separate feature, and this build does not exercise it. Taken from the header comment in `mkdocs.yml`.
sections.Where it lives:
* **Repository**: [`knowledge-as-code`](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code), at `docs`, configured by
  `mkdocs.yml` at the root
* **Platform**: Zensical, with its `modern` theme, pinned in `docs/requirements.txt`
* **Deployed as**: a static site uploaded as a Pages artifact by `publish-docs.yml`
sections.Dependencies:
None in this catalogue. The site is static HTML. It calls nothing.

The packages that build it are in the tool register:

* [tol-zensical](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b61e5891804d5b7c99885eb005c35a0c257dc581/examples/dog-fooding/tools/docs/zensical.md)

The actions that build and publish it are there too:

* [tol-checkout](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b61e5891804d5b7c99885eb005c35a0c257dc581/examples/dog-fooding/tools/workflows/checkout.md)
* [tol-github-pages](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/b61e5891804d5b7c99885eb005c35a0c257dc581/examples/dog-fooding/tools/workflows/github-pages.md)
